blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction 1.0 導論
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: MDR (Medical Device Regulation, 醫療器材法規)：這是歐盟於 2017 年發布、2021 年 5 月 26 日正式施行的醫療器材新法規，取代了舊有的 Directive 93/42/EEC。MDR 對預充填注射器 (PFS) 的「器材部分 (device part)」提出了更嚴格的安全與性能要求。
blocks.en: MDR (Medical Device Regulation): The new EU medical device regulation, published in 2017 and applied from 26 May 2021, which replaced the former Directive 93/42/EEC. The MDR sets stricter safety and performance requirements for the "device part" of a prefilled syringe (PFS).

blocks.zh: GSPRs (General Safety and Performance Requirements, 一般安全與性能要求)：MDR Annex I 所列出的全面性要求清單，涵蓋設計、材料、生物相容性、化學穩定性等多個面向。PFS 的器材部分必須逐項滿足相關 GSPRs。
blocks.en: GSPRs (General Safety and Performance Requirements): The comprehensive list of requirements in MDR Annex I, covering design, materials, biocompatibility, chemical stability and more. The device part of a PFS must meet each relevant GSPR.

blocks.zh: Notified Body (NB, 認證機構)：經歐盟認可的第三方評估機構，負責審查 PFS 器材部分是否符合 MDR 要求，並出具正式意見 (NB Opinion)。
blocks.en: Notified Body (NB): An EU-designated third-party assessment body that reviews whether the device part of a PFS complies with the MDR and issues a formal opinion (NB Opinion).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 可以把 MDR 的 GSPRs 想像成一張「建築安全檢查清單」。就像蓋房子需要通過結構、消防、水電等各項安全檢查一樣，預充填注射器的器材部分也需要逐一通過 GSPRs 的各項安全與性能要求。而 Notified Body 就像是「建築檢查員」，負責審核你的設計文件和測試報告，確認一切合規後才能核發許可。
blocks.en: Think of the MDR GSPRs as a "building safety checklist". Just as a building must pass structural, fire and electrical inspections, the device part of a prefilled syringe must satisfy each of the GSPRs for safety and performance. The Notified Body acts as the "building inspector": it reviews your design documents and test reports and grants approval only once everything is confirmed compliant.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TR-73-2 代表的是「當前的知識狀態 (current state of knowledge)」。由於 MDR 仍是相對新的法規框架，不同的 NB 和各國主管機關 (Competent Authorities) 的期望可能存在差異。這意味著：
blocks.en: TR-73-2 represents the "current state of knowledge". Because the MDR is still a relatively new regulatory framework, the expectations of different NBs and national Competent Authorities may differ. This means:

blocks.zh: 申請者不能完全依賴單一指引，需要保持對法規演變的關注
blocks.en: Applicants cannot rely on any single guidance document and need to keep following regulatory developments

blocks.zh: 提交文件的最終責任在申請者 (applicant) 本身
blocks.en: The final responsibility for the submitted documentation rests with the applicant

blocks.zh: 藥廠、供應商和其他相關方都是本報告的目標讀者
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical companies, suppliers and other interested parties are all target readers of this report

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: MDR 與舊有的 Directive 93/42/EEC 最關鍵的差異是什麼？為何對藥廠影響巨大？
blocks.en: What is the most critical difference between the MDR and the former Directive 93/42/EEC? Why does it have such a large impact on pharmaceutical companies?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 NB Opinion 對於 PFS 的上市至關重要？如果沒有取得 NB Opinion，後果是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the NB Opinion essential for marketing a PFS? What are the consequences of not obtaining one?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 1.1 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: TR-73 與 TR-73-2 的關係：TR-73 是原始的預充填注射器使用者需求技術報告（針對生物技術應用），而 TR-73-2 是其增補版 (addendum)，專門聚焦於如何準備 MDR 所要求的器材部分文件，以順利取得 NB Opinion。
blocks.en: Relationship between TR-73 and TR-73-2: TR-73 is the original technical report on user requirements for prefilled syringes (for biotechnology applications), while TR-73-2 is its addendum, focused specifically on how to prepare the device part documentation required by the MDR in order to obtain an NB Opinion.

blocks.zh: MDR Annex II (Technical Documentation, 技術文件)：這是 MDR 規範的技術文件結構框架。TR-73-2 建議遵循此框架來組織提交文件，但各章節的詳細程度可由申請者自行決定。
blocks.en: MDR Annex II (Technical Documentation): This is the structural framework for technical documentation under the MDR. TR-73-2 recommends following this framework to organize the submission, but the level of detail in each section is left to the applicant.

blocks.zh: 如果把 TR-73 比作一本「如何設計好注射器」的教科書，那麼 TR-73-2 就是一本「如何準備考試申請資料」的指南。兩者缺一不可 -- 你不僅需要設計出好產品，還需要知道如何把合規證據有條理地呈現給審查員 (NB)。
blocks.en: If TR-73 is a textbook on "how to design a good syringe", then TR-73-2 is a guide on "how to prepare your application for the exam". You need both: you must not only design a good product, but also know how to present the compliance evidence to the reviewer (NB) in an orderly way.

blocks.zh: TR-73-2 的核心價值在 Table 5.1-1🔍：它逐項列出每個 GSPR 所需的資訊深度與廣度。這就像一張「通關清單」，幫助藥廠確認每項要求是否已充分準備支持證據。Team-NB 的立場文件也提供了額外的實務指引，建議一併參考。
blocks.en: The core value of TR-73-2 lies in Table 5.1-1🔍: it lists, GSPR by GSPR, the depth and breadth of information required. It works like a "clearance checklist" that helps pharmaceutical companies confirm whether supporting evidence has been adequately prepared for each requirement. The Team-NB position paper also offers additional practical guidance and should be consulted alongside.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 或藥廠而言，準備 NB 提交文件是一項跨部門的系統工程。建議在專案初期就依照 MDR Annex II 的架構建立文件管理系統，並指派專人負責追蹤每項 GSPR 的證據蒐集進度。提早規劃可避免後期「補考」式的匆忙補件。
blocks.en: For a CDMO or pharmaceutical company, preparing the NB submission is a cross-functional, systematic undertaking. We recommend setting up a document management system based on the MDR Annex II structure at the start of the project, and assigning a dedicated owner to track the progress of evidence gathering for each GSPR. Early planning avoids a last-minute "resit"-style scramble to fill gaps.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope 1.2 範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: Staked Needle Syringe (膠針注射器)：針頭直接固定於針筒上的注射器，針頭無法拆卸。這是本報告的核心對象。相對地，Luer lock（鎖定式接頭）和 Luer cone（圓錐式接頭）型注射器不在範圍內。
blocks.en: Staked Needle Syringe: A syringe whose needle is permanently fixed to the barrel and cannot be detached. This is the core subject of this report. By contrast, Luer lock and Luer cone syringes are out of scope.

blocks.zh: Device Part vs. Drug (器材部分 vs. 藥品)：NB 只評估器材部分（針筒、針頭、針頭護套、活塞桿等），藥品本身不在 NB 的審查範圍內，藥品由藥品主管機關（如 EMA）負責。
blocks.en: Device Part vs. Drug: The NB assesses only the device part (barrel, needle, needle shield, plunger rod, etc.). The drug itself is outside the NB's review and is the responsibility of the medicines authority (e.g., EMA).

blocks.zh: Fixed Dose (固定劑量)：本報告僅涵蓋固定劑量的 PFS，不包括需要量測功能的可變劑量設計。
blocks.en: Fixed Dose: This report covers only fixed-dose PFS and excludes variable-dose designs that require a measuring function.

blocks.zh: TR-73-2 的範圍比 TR-73 更廣：
blocks.en: The scope of TR-73-2 is broader than that of TR-73:

blocks.zh: 材料：不限於玻璃，也涵蓋高分子 (polymer) 針筒
blocks.en: Material: Not limited to glass; polymer syringe barrels are also covered

blocks.zh: 容量：不限於 1 mL，適用於不同容量
blocks.en: Volume: Not limited to 1 mL; applicable to different volumes

blocks.zh: 應用：不僅限於生物技術產品，涵蓋所有注射型藥品
blocks.en: Application: Not limited to biotechnology products; covers all injectable drug products

blocks.zh: 但請注意：包裝 (Packaging) 雖不在範圍內，若包裝相關證據（如運送研究、使用者標示）會影響器材部分，仍應納入 NB 提交文件中。
blocks.en: Note, however: although packaging is out of scope, packaging-related evidence (such as shipping studies and user labeling) that affects the device part should still be included in the NB submission.

blocks.zh: 可以把 Table 1.2-1🔍 想像成一個「考試範圍公告」。就像學生需要知道哪些章節會考、哪些不考一樣，藥廠需要清楚知道哪些元件會被 NB 評估、哪些不會。不在範圍內的項目（如 autoinjector、針頭安全裝置）可能有其他法規要求，但不屬於本報告的「考試範圍」。
blocks.en: Think of Table 1.2-1🔍 as an "exam syllabus announcement". Just as students need to know which chapters will be examined and which will not, pharmaceutical companies need to know clearly which components the NB will assess and which it will not. Items outside the scope (such as autoinjectors and needle safety devices) may be subject to other regulatory requirements, but they are not part of the "exam syllabus" of this report.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 1.2-1🔍 的關鍵要點：
blocks.en: Key points of Table 1.2-1🔍:

blocks.zh: Autoinjector (自動注射器)：不在範圍內，因為它屬於更複雜的器材系統，有專門的法規要求
blocks.en: Autoinjector: Out of scope, because it is a more complex device system with its own specific regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: ATMP (先進治療藥品)：不在 MDR 適用範圍內，因此也不在本報告範圍內
blocks.en: ATMP (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Product): Not covered by the MDR, and therefore also outside the scope of this report

blocks.zh: Intravitreal (玻璃體內注射)：排除在外，因為此類 PFS 通常不採用膠針設計
blocks.en: Intravitreal: Excluded, because PFS for this use generally do not have a staked needle design

blocks.zh: Non-EU regulatory frameworks：本報告僅聚焦歐盟法規，其他地區（如 FDA、PMDA）的要求不在討論範圍內
blocks.en: Non-EU regulatory frameworks: This report focuses only on EU regulations; requirements in other regions (e.g., FDA, PMDA) are not discussed

blocks.zh: 為什麼包裝 (Packaging) 被列為 out of scope，但仍可能需要納入 NB 提交文件？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: Why is packaging listed as out of scope, yet may still need to be included in the NB submission? Please give an example.

blocks.zh: 如果一家藥廠使用 polymer PFS 搭配 staked needle 來充填皮下注射的生物藥品，這個產品是否在 TR-73-2 的範圍內？
blocks.en: If a pharmaceutical company uses a polymer PFS with a staked needle to fill a biologic for subcutaneous injection, is this product within the scope of TR-73-2?

blocks.zh: Dual-chamber PFS 為什麼被排除在範圍外？這與技術設計有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why is a dual-chamber PFS excluded from the scope? How does this relate to its technical design?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations 2.0 術語彙編與縮寫
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 2.1 Glossary 2.1 術語彙編
blocks.en: 2.1 Glossary

blocks.zh: Drug-Device Combination, DDC (藥品-器材組合產品)：這是本報告最核心的概念之一。DDC 指的是藥品與醫療器材組合成不可重複使用的一體化產品，且藥品作用為主要 (principal) 作用。PFS 就是一個典型的 DDC：針筒是器材部分，藥液是藥品部分，兩者組合成一體化產品。
blocks.en: Drug-Device Combination, DDC: This is one of the most central concepts in this report. A DDC is a product in which a drug and a medical device form a single integral product that is not reusable, and in which the action of the drug is the principal one. A PFS is a typical DDC: the syringe is the device part and the liquid is the drug part, combined into one integral product.

blocks.zh: Article 1(8) vs. Article 1(9) 的區別：
blocks.en: Difference between Article 1(8) and Article 1(9):

blocks.zh: Article 1(8)：器材「內含」藥物性質的物質，若該物質的作用是主要的，則整個產品按藥品法規管理
blocks.en: Article 1(8): A device that "incorporates" a substance with medicinal properties; if the action of that substance is principal, the whole product is regulated as a medicinal product

blocks.zh: Article 1(9), subparagraph 2：器材與藥品以單一整合產品上市、不可重複使用，則由 Directive 2001/83/EC 管理（即藥品法規為主導）
blocks.en: Article 1(9), subparagraph 2: A device and a medicinal product placed on the market as a single integral product that is not reusable is governed by Directive 2001/83/EC (i.e., medicinal product law takes precedence)

blocks.zh: PFS 主要適用 Article 1(9), subparagraph 2 的情境。
blocks.en: A PFS mainly falls under the situation described in Article 1(9), subparagraph 2.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語對照 Key Term Reference
blocks.en: Key Term Reference

blocks.zh: Direct Contact (直接接觸)：元件直接接觸人體組織。例如：針頭刺入皮膚、針筒內壁接觸藥液後注入體內。
blocks.en: Direct Contact: The component directly contacts human tissue. Example: the needle penetrating the skin.

blocks.zh: Indirect Contact (間接接觸)：元件不直接接觸組織，但液體或氣體通過它後才接觸人體。例如：針筒內壁（藥液通過後注入體內）。
blocks.en: Indirect Contact: The component does not contact tissue directly, but a liquid or gas passes through or over it before reaching the body. Example: the inner wall of the barrel (the drug solution passes over it before being injected into the body).

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity, CCI (容器密封完整性)：容器密封系統在整個保存期限內維持無菌性和產品品質的能力。這是 PFS 的關鍵品質屬性。
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity, CCI: The ability of the container closure system to maintain sterility and product quality throughout the shelf life. This is a critical quality attribute of a PFS.

blocks.zh: Processing Aids (加工助劑)：如矽油 (silicone oil)、脫模劑等，不屬於配方的一部分，但可能以低量殘留存在於成品中。這些殘留 (Processing Residues) 需要被評估和管控。
blocks.en: Processing Aids: Substances such as silicone oil and mold release agents that are not part of the formulation but may remain in the finished product at low levels. These Processing Residues must be evaluated and controlled.

blocks.zh: DDC 的概念可以用「即食便當」來理解。便當盒（器材）和食物（藥品）組合成一體化產品，消費者吃完就丟棄（不可重複使用）。食物（藥品）的功能是主要的，但便當盒（器材）必須符合食品安全容器的標準。在法規上，這個「即食便當」主要由食品法規管理，但便當盒部分仍需符合容器安全要求 -- 這就像 PFS 主要由藥品法規管理，但器材部分需符合 MDR GSPRs。
blocks.en: The DDC concept can be understood through a "ready meal". The lunch box (device) and the food (drug) form one integral product, and the consumer throws it away after eating (not reusable). The function of the food (drug) is the principal one, but the lunch box (device) must still meet food-safe container standards. From a regulatory standpoint, this "ready meal" is mainly governed by food law, but the box still has to meet container safety requirements -- just as a PFS is mainly governed by medicinal product law, while its device part must meet the MDR GSPRs.

blocks.zh: 詞彙表中有幾個容易混淆的概念需要特別注意：
blocks.en: Several concepts in the glossary are easily confused and deserve special attention:

blocks.zh: Syringe Components (注射器元件)：包括所有零件（針筒、針頭、護套、活塞、活塞桿、止退器）
blocks.en: Syringe Components: All individual parts (barrel, needle, shield, stopper, plunger rod, backstop)

blocks.zh: Syringe Subassembly Ready for Filling (待充填注射器組件)：已清洗和滅菌的針筒+針頭+護套組件，是充填製程的起始材料
blocks.en: Syringe Subassembly Ready for Filling: The cleaned and sterilized barrel + needle + shield assembly, which is the starting material for the filling process

blocks.zh: Device Part (器材部分)：= Syringe Subassembly + 活塞桿 + 護套 + 指法蘭延伸件
blocks.en: Device Part: = Syringe Subassembly + plunger rod + shield + finger flange extension

blocks.zh: 這三個層級的區分對於理解後續 GSPR 的適用範圍至關重要。
blocks.en: Distinguishing these three levels is essential for understanding the applicable scope of the later GSPRs.

blocks.zh: State of the Art, SOTA (技術現狀) -- 特別說明
blocks.en: State of the Art, SOTA -- Special Note

blocks.zh: SOTA 在 MDR 中具有特殊的法律意義。它不僅指「最新技術」，更指「基於科學、技術和經驗的綜合成果所達到的當前技術水準和/或公認的臨床實踐」。在準備 GSPR 證據時，必須證明你的設計和製造符合 SOTA。這意味著需要引用相關標準 (harmonised standards)、指引文件和已發表的科學文獻。
blocks.en: SOTA has a particular legal meaning under the MDR. It does not simply mean the "latest technology"; it refers to "what is accepted as good practice in technology and medicine", i.e., the current level of technology and/or accepted clinical practice reached on the basis of the combined results of science, technology and experience. When preparing GSPR evidence, you must demonstrate that your design and manufacture conform to the SOTA. This means citing relevant standards (harmonised standards), guidance documents and published scientific literature.

blocks.zh: 請說明 Direct Contact 和 Indirect Contact 的差異，並舉例說明 PFS 中哪些元件屬於哪一類？
blocks.en: Please explain the difference between Direct Contact and Indirect Contact, and give examples of which PFS components fall into each category.

blocks.zh: Processing Aids 和 Processing Residues 的差異是什麼？為什麼這個區分在 MDR 合規中很重要？
blocks.en: What is the difference between Processing Aids and Processing Residues? Why does this distinction matter for MDR compliance?

blocks.zh: Device Part 包含哪些具體元件？它與 Syringe Components 和 Syringe Subassembly 有何不同？
blocks.en: Which specific components does the Device Part include? How does it differ from Syringe Components and Syringe Subassembly?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Abbreviations 2.2 縮寫
blocks.en: 2.2 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 縮寫分類速查 Abbreviation Categories
blocks.en: Abbreviation Categories

blocks.zh: 可將這些縮寫分為以下幾類以便記憶：
blocks.en: These abbreviations can be grouped into the following categories to make them easier to remember:

blocks.zh: 法規相關：
blocks.en: Regulatory:

blocks.zh: MDR - 醫療器材法規（歐盟核心法規）
blocks.en: MDR - Medical Device Regulation (the core EU regulation)

blocks.zh: GSPR - 一般安全與性能要求（MDR Annex I）
blocks.en: GSPR - General Safety and Performance Requirements (MDR Annex I)

blocks.zh: NB / NBOp - 認證機構 / 認證機構意見
blocks.en: NB / NBOp - Notified Body / Notified Body Opinion

blocks.zh: MAA - 上市許可申請
blocks.en: MAA - Marketing Authorisation Application

blocks.zh: EMA - 歐洲藥品管理局
blocks.en: EMA - European Medicines Agency

blocks.zh: 產品相關：
blocks.en: Product-related:

blocks.zh: PFS - 預充填注射器
blocks.en: PFS - Prefilled Syringe

blocks.zh: DDC - 藥品-器材組合產品
blocks.en: DDC - Drug-Device Combination product

blocks.zh: NS / RNS - 針頭護套 / 硬式針頭護套
blocks.en: NS / RNS - Needle Shield / Rigid Needle Shield

blocks.zh: CCI - 容器密封完整性
blocks.en: CCI - Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: 風險/安全相關：
blocks.en: Risk/safety-related:

blocks.zh: RM / RMS - 風險管理 / 風險管理系統
blocks.en: RM / RMS - Risk Management / Risk Management System

blocks.zh: CMR - 致癌性、致突變性或生殖毒性
blocks.en: CMR - Carcinogenic, Mutagenic or toxic to Reproduction

blocks.zh: ED - 內分泌干擾物質
blocks.en: ED - Endocrine Disrupting substances

blocks.zh: TSE/BSE - 傳染性海綿狀腦病 / 牛海綿狀腦病
blocks.en: TSE/BSE - Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathy / Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy

blocks.zh: CMR 和 ED 是 MDR 中特別關注的材料安全議題。MDR 要求製造商評估器材中是否含有 CMR 物質（致癌、致突變、生殖毒性物質）或 ED 物質（內分泌干擾物質），並在技術文件中提供相關證據。這將在後續 GSPR 評估中詳細討論。
blocks.en: CMR and ED are material safety issues of particular concern under the MDR. The MDR requires manufacturers to assess whether the device contains CMR substances (carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction) or ED substances (endocrine-disrupting substances), and to provide relevant evidence in the technical documentation. These are discussed in detail in the later GSPR evaluation.

blocks.zh: TSE/BSE 涉及動物源性材料的安全性評估。如果 PFS 元件（如彈性體護套）使用了動物源性原料，必須提供 TSE/BSE 風險評估。
blocks.en: TSE/BSE relates to the safety assessment of materials of animal origin. If a PFS component (such as an elastomeric shield) uses raw materials of animal origin, a TSE/BSE risk assessment must be provided.

blocks.zh: NBOp (Notified Body Opinion) 在 PFS 上市流程中扮演什麼角色？它與傳統醫療器材的 CE marking 有何不同？
blocks.en: What role does the NBOp (Notified Body Opinion) play in the PFS marketing process? How does it differ from CE marking for a conventional medical device?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CMR 和 ED 物質的評估對 PFS 特別重要？請思考 PFS 中可能含有這類物質的元件有哪些？
blocks.en: Why is the assessment of CMR and ED substances especially important for a PFS? Consider which PFS components might contain such substances.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 法規背景：MDR (EU) 2017/745 取代了舊有的醫療器材指令，對 PFS 的器材部分提出新的 GSPRs 合規要求，需取得 NB Opinion
blocks.en: Regulatory background: MDR (EU) 2017/745 replaced the former medical device directives and imposes new GSPR compliance requirements on the device part of a PFS, for which an NB Opinion is needed

blocks.zh: 報告定位：TR-73-2 是 TR-73 的增補版，專注於指引藥廠如何準備 NB 提交文件，Table 5.1-1🔍 是核心參考工具
blocks.en: Positioning of the report: TR-73-2 is an addendum to TR-73 and focuses on guiding pharmaceutical companies in preparing the NB submission; Table 5.1-1🔍 is the core reference tool

blocks.zh: 範圍界定：適用於玻璃和高分子材質、不同容量的膠針型 PFS（固定劑量），不包括 autoinjector、針頭安全裝置、ATMP 和非歐盟法規
blocks.en: Scope: Applies to staked needle PFS (fixed dose) in glass and polymer materials and in different volumes; excludes autoinjectors, needle safety devices, ATMPs and non-EU regulations

blocks.zh: DDC 分類：PFS 屬於 MDR Article 1(9) subparagraph 2 定義的單一整合產品，主要由藥品法規管理，但器材部分需符合 MDR Annex I
blocks.en: DDC classification: A PFS is a single integral product as defined in MDR Article 1(9) subparagraph 2; it is mainly governed by medicinal product law, but its device part must comply with MDR Annex I

blocks.zh: 關鍵層級：Syringe Components（零件）→ Syringe Subassembly（待充填組件）→ Device Part（器材部分）→ DDC（最終組合產品），每個層級有不同的 GSPR 適用範圍
blocks.en: Key levels: Syringe Components (parts) → Syringe Subassembly (assembly ready for filling) → Device Part → DDC (final combination product); each level has a different GSPR applicable scope

blocks.zh: 材料安全：CMR、ED 物質和 TSE/BSE 評估是 MDR 特別關注的材料安全議題，將在後續 GSPR 章節中深入探討
blocks.en: Material safety: CMR, ED substances and TSE/BSE assessment are material safety issues of particular concern under the MDR and will be discussed in depth in the later GSPR sections
